purpose: Define non-mergeability of merit, Tier, recommendation and trust histories across distinct IdentityCore identities.

owns: Identity Evidence Isolation and No-Merge semantics

value.history_rule: Each identity owns an independent MeritCore history.
value.merge_rule: Merit, Tier, recommendation and trust evidence from two identities cannot be combined by ordinary identity editing.
value.reset_rule: Creating a new identity starts a new independent history.
value.forfeit_rule: Identity reset/new identity does not inherit prior identity merits by implication.
value.portfolio_rule: Portfolio references may point to shared external artifacts only through explicit independent evidence.
value.dedupe_rule: Similarity of names/contact data never merges identities.
value.authority_rule: No-merge semantics are evidence-integrity rules, not AccessCore policy.

value.purpose: Define non-mergeability of merit, Tier, recommendation and trust histories across distinct IdentityCore identities.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

hard_gates.condition: new account inherits old Tier automatically

references.purpose: Isolation applies to exact canonical identities.
